review.reason: Candidate 8 is publishable as-is. The artwork maps confidently left-to-right to the same holes as the numbered previews: Hole 1 is the no-water punchbowl par 3 with left-side bunkering, Hole 2 is the reachable par 5 with the long lake on the right, and Hole 3 is the cape par 4 with the long lake on the left. The lake extents and overall fairway/green proportions are close enough to the geometry, and I do not see a clear bunker-side contradiction that warrants a safe parameter change. Strategically, the set is strong: Hole 1 offers a sensible ground-based or direct play into a long punchbowl target, Hole 2 has a real safe-left versus aggressive-lake-side par-5 decision, and Hole 3 gives a classic cape choice with more water carry buying a shorter approach. Variety within the round is excellent with par 3/5/4 sequencing, one dry hole, then water right, then water left. With no recent published rounds supplied, across-days variety is also excellent. Difficulty is testing but fair: the hazards are meaningful, yet the simulated safe options remain solid on all three holes and the landing space is not unreasonably squeezed.
